shortDescription: Thailand's Senate on Friday passed the government's 3.788 trillion baht ($114.3 billion) budget bill for the 2027 fiscal year, beginning on October 1.The bill will need royal approval before it can be enacted.($1 = 33.14 baht)

children: Thailand's Senate on Friday passed the government's 3.788 trillion baht ($114.3 billion) budget bill for the 2027 fiscal year, beginning on October 1.
The bill will need royal approval before it can be enacted.
